pairs.subject: table
pairs.evidence: apps/console/src/data/paged.ts:16 usePaged/usePagedMany follow the server cursor chain to effectively every page by default and concatenate the pages into one client-held list. That puts the console in the all-client regime with no stated bound on dataset growth: 10,000 pages is labelled a loop guard, not a size bet, and the `more` flag only fires at that cap.

techniques.evidence: apps/console/src/data/paged.ts:16 The default chain fetches the whole set (the comment at line 15 reads 'effectively every page (a cursor loop guard)'). The technique requires the all-client growth bet to be written down as an upper bound with a guard that warns or flips; the simulator callers (Runs, Tournaments, Verdicts, Heatmap) rely on this default.

apps/console/src/data/paged.ts:162 Keyset-style continuation: the client only replays the server's opaque next_cursor string and never fabricates a position. A changed base (filter or limit) produces a new key set and a fresh chain, so a cursor is never reused under a different predicate.

apps/console/src/data/paged.ts:223 Loaded rows win over a later error. Status is 'error' only when no page exists, and 'loading' until the first page settles; data stays undefined until then, so empty is only asserted after settling.
apps/console/src/data/cache.ts:231 An identical refetch keeps the same object reference, and paged.ts:121 keeps the folded list for the same reason, so refreshes do not re-render memoized rows.

apps/console/src/data/cache.ts:228 Latest wins: replies are keyed by method+params, a superseded fetch is aborted (line 221), and a late reply is dropped. Rows from an old predicate therefore cannot land under a new one. The entered-vs-applied split belongs to the page UI, not to this layer.

pairs.registryProposal: The table subject could say how a shared data layer that feeds many tables should state the all-client growth bet. One layer-wide default page cap ('effectively every page') hides the per-table bound the technique asks for, so the bound probably belongs at each call site with the layer providing a guard or warning.
